description:
## Objective

Map every public component to its required quality proof.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U22`
Covers: `R12` through `R16`; `KTD10`, `KTD13`, `KTD16`

Covenant has 40 active components and 323 active obligations. This task makes public module ownership and fuzz or property applicability complete and machine-validated.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: `jido-07x.21` for the validated quality-contract schema.
- Unblocks: `jido-07x.23` for component coverage mapping.

## Branch and integration rule

- Base: `main` after the completed U21 ticket.
- Combine: Execute directly on `main` per KTD16. Do not create a branch, worktree, or pull request.

## Source inventory

- 40 active Covenant components in `test/contracts/coverage.json` — map all.
- 323 active Covenant obligations in `test/contracts/coverage.json` — preserve 100% coverage.
- 354 production source files under `lib/` — classify their public modules through Reach and Covenant ownership.

## API and behavior map

- Covenant component IDs -> primary behavior owners. Evidence: `test/contracts/README.md` and `test/contracts/coverage.json`.
- Reach modules -> one Covenant component owner. Evidence: `.reach.exs`.
- Public component API -> required fuzz or property proof, or validated not-applicable result. Evidence: `test/property/**` and contract tests.

## Files

- Read: `.reach.exs`, `lib/**`, `test/contracts/README.md`, `test/contracts/coverage.json`, `test/property/**`, `test/authoring/**`
- Change: `test/quality/quality_contract.yml`, `test/quality/README.md`
- Add: `test/quality/component_proof.yml`, `test/quality/component_proof_test.exs`
- Do not change: `lib/**`, `../refs/**`, Covenant obligation meaning
- Expected shared changes: None

## Instructions

1. Derive active components and public production modules from current repository evidence.
2. Map each public module to exactly one primary component owner.
3. Record unit, Covenant, authoring, example, property, and fuzz proof states for each component.
4. Require a reason and owner for each not-applicable proof state.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All 40 active components have one proof entry.
- [ ] A new component without an entry fails.
- [ ] A public module with zero or two primary owners fails.
- [ ] A fuzz-required component without a fuzz group fails.
- [ ] A not-applicable entry without reason and owner fails.
- [ ] No file under `lib/**` or `../refs/**` changes.

## Verification

- `mix test test/quality/component_proof_test.exs --seed 0` — exits with status `0`.
- `mix test.contracts` — reports 323 of 323 active obligations and exits with status `0`.
- `mix reach.check --arch` — exits with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, component counts, proof classifications, verification results, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.
title: Map public components to required proof
